intent_record.intent_summary: Corrects the fast evaluation logic to explicitly skip connection tracking templates, preventing them from being processed as active connections.
intent_record.what: Modified the conditional check in nft_ct_get_fast_eval from 'if (!ct)' to 'if (!ct || nf_ct_is_template(ct))'.
intent_record.how: Ensures that connection tracking templates are treated identically to null pointers during fast evaluation, triggering an early return with a break verdict instead of proceeding with template data.

grouping_result.intent: Corrects the fast evaluation logic to explicitly skip connection tracking templates, preventing them from being processed as active connections.

vuln_statements.explanation: This NFT_CT_STATE case validates ct pointer only partially (line 69: if (ct)) but unlike subsequent cases (lines 81-82) which check '!ct || nf_ct_is_template(ct)', this early return path doesn't properly validate connection tracking object validity before proceeding, potentially allowing NULL pointer dereference or invalid memory access when ct is NULL but execution continues past this switch case.

Same vulnerability pattern as nft_ct.c - the fast path handler has identical incomplete ct validation in the NFT_CT_STATE case. Improper validation of the 'ct' pointer before accessing ct fields could lead to null pointer dereference or use-after-free vulnerabilities when the connection tracking object is invalid or NULL.
